data.name: abeliel
data.gender_notes: abeliel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of the second son of Adam and Eve according to the Book of Genesis, derived from the Hebrew words ‘ābhel’ meaning ‘breath’ and ‘el’ meaning ‘God'. Abel was a shepherd, and Cain, his elder brother, was a farmer. Their rivalry ended in Cain murdering Abel, marking the beginning of sin and conflict in the world. The name abeliel carries the meaning “Breath of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose abeliel usually hope their child will grow to embody breath of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the breath of God and the beginning of life.
data.etymology: abeliel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of abeliel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אַבְּלִיאֵל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אַבְּלִיאֵל הוא שם עברי שמשמעו אלוהים אבי, ומורכב משני חלקים: אב שפירושו אב, ואל שפירושו אלוהים, השם הזה משמש כשם פרטי ונפוץ בקרב יהודים ונוצרים, ומבטא את האמונה באלוהים כאב הכל יכול

in_greek.name: Αβελιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αβελιήλ είναι eine ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος אַבְּלִיאֵל, και σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι πατήρ, και αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: τον πατέρα και τον Θεόν, το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιείται ως προσωπικό όνομα και είναι διαδεδομένο μεταξύ Εβραίων και Χριστιανών, και εκφράζει την πίστη στον Θεό ως τον Παντοδύναμο Πατέρα

in_latin.name: Abeliel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Abeliel est forma latina nominis hebraici אַבְּלִיאֵל, et significat Deus est pater, et constat ex duobus partibus: pater et Deus, nomen hoc utitur ut nomen personale et est diffusum inter Iudaeos et Christianos, et exprimit fidem in Deum ut Patrem Omnipotentem

in_english.name: Abeliel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abeliel is derived from the Hebrew name אַבְּלִיאֵל, and means God is my father, and consists of two parts: ab meaning father, and el meaning God, this name is used as a personal name and is popular among Jews and Christians, and expresses the belief in God as the All-Powerful Father

data.cultural_impact: The name "Abeliel" has ancient roots dating back to the Biblical account of the second son of Adam and Eve. It's an isolated yet meaningful name, evoking images of antiquity, shepherding, and the exquisite bond between brothers. This intriguing name has even been adopted by various Christian communities across the globe, inspiring numerous works of art, literature, and even contemporary musical compositions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Abeliel" carries profound spiritual significance, summoning the memory of the righteous Abel, whose unwavering faith, piety, and dedication to his livestock earned him favor in the sight of God. Tragically, his untimely death at the hands of his own brother, Cain, serves as a solemn reminder of the potential for both good and evil within human nature. Despite the grave comprising his life, Abel's story has stood the test of time, inspiring generations with its powerful themes of devotion, sacrifice, and redemption.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Abeliel: God is my father; my father is the source of my being and strength. This name conveys a deep trust in and dependence upon God as one's true and ultimate source of life and guidance.

In medieval Europe, Abeliel was the name of a monk at the English monastery of Ramesey Abbey, who was famed for his miraculous healing abilities.

His presence in the crypto space is a testament to the fusion of ancient names with modern technology.
